I chose this insurer because it seemed an easy option, but it is virtually impossible to communicate with them. Phone is often a glitch so they're unreachable, resulting in zero communication. The only time I was actually reached I attempted to change my bank account and address, but this turned out later to be totally not implemented." Also they are complaining, but the primary request is to end contract. According to rule 3: If two requests appear, pick the one the customer needs answered first. The email expresses a desire to change insurer. They also mention that they have tried to change bank account and address, but no response. They want to cancel. So category is CANCELLATION. Language is NL.

Thus answer: 
CATEGORY: CANCELLATION
LANGUAGE: NL
